foo6_cb.smtDecl: (declare-fun foo6_cb ((_ BitVec 32) (_ BitVec 32) (_ BitVec 32) (_ BitVec 32) (_ BitVec 32) (_ BitVec 32)) (_ BitVec 32))
foo6_cb.desc: foo6_cb takes six 32-bit inputs, computes their sum modulo 7, and returns that value. If the result is 3, the function instead returns 5. Therefore, the function never outputs 3.
